sentence: This project builds blood-based immune markers from DNA methylation to predict survival of glioma patients and to judge the effects of radiation and immunotherapy.
This project builds computer tools that learn from genotype and phenotype data to predict traits and find genes that interact with each other.
This project tries to develop drug candidates that fight fungal infections by working as inhibitors of acetyl CoA synthetase.
This project studies how genes are regulated in three regions of the brains of people dependent on opioids, comparing overdose cases with controls.
This project studies how a signaling pathway in cancer is regulated and how it drives tumor initiation and progression.
This project builds an image-guided histotripsy system to treat osteosarcoma, a bone tumor, in a complete, uniform and non-invasive way.
This project builds instruments and methods that separate, identify and measure lipid isomers in complex biological samples.
This project studies how the brain processes visual information during natural social perception and how brain regions work together.
This project studies how problems in immune cells and molecules in the brain lead to hyperexcitability in Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies why some kidney cancer patients respond to a drug that blocks a protein while others resist it, and how to treat them.
This project builds algorithms that process images to reduce uncertainty and improve the radiotherapy dose delivered to patients.
This project studies how mutations in a gene disrupt the development and function of immune cells and how these cells are controlled.
This project studies how the prefrontal microcircuit changes during normal aging and Alzheimer's disease, using recordings and computational models.
This project builds statistical machine learning methods that use imaging, genomic and clinical data to compare brain and genomic networks and to diagnose Alzheimer's disease.
This project develops a vaccine against Pseudomonas aeruginosa, a cause of hospital-acquired lung infections, and tests it in mice and nonhuman primates.
This project builds methods that use sampling time to improve estimates of malaria parasite spread and to forecast future parasite migration and drug resistance.
This project uses artificial intelligence and molecular profiling to find distinct subtypes of bronchopulmonary dysplasia, a lung disease of preterm neonates.
This project uses long read sequencing to find which spliced isoforms of genes are expressed in the kidney and their role in kidney disease.
This project studies what predicts opioid and cocaine use in formerly incarcerated people and whether they receive adequate addiction treatment.
